question: Can root-cause analysis, the only secpatch task where thinking paid in COT-EFF-2, keep thinking-on accuracy at >= 3.2x less wall time?
why: COT-EFF-2 calibration: the best accuracy-keeping policy (task_N_B_T_N, 3.2x) spends 52% of its wall time on root_cause with full thinking (135 s/item; thinking off got 1/6 vs 4/6). Every other task is already fast. With the other tasks unchanged, the whole policy reaches 5x only if root cause runs at <= ~42 s/item, i.e. >= 3.2x faster than T, with no loss. Hypothesis: classifying the weakness is largely recognition, so labelled analogies retrieved from the training split can stand in for long reasoning.
hardware: Slink: Ryzen 9 3900X, 62 GiB DDR4, RTX 2070 SUPER 8 GiB; the forge GLM-4.7-Flash teacher stays resident on the GPU (2.5 GiB) as an allowed neighbour

arms.lever: same model, thinking off (Model Lab default)
thinking off + 3 nearest training-split root-cause fixes with their recorded CWE

arms.lever: budget forcing at 512 + the same 3 labelled cases
Liquid LFM2.5-8B-A1B with thinking budget + the same 3 labelled cases
arms.sampling_note: Liquid's published LFM2 generation settings, so the fast arm is not handicapped by Qwen's sampling

cases: CWECases over a training-split train.jsonl (secpatch data-v3-multi: single- and multi-function root_cause rows). Nearest by 5-gram shingle Jaccard on the vulnerable code; cases from the item's own repository are excluded (dev shares repositories with training, only later in time; held-out repositories are disjoint by construction). Build-time leakage control already removed training functions with Jaccard >= 0.8 to any dev/held-out function.

sets.rc-calibration: eval-dev root_cause, 40 items, seed 20261031, excluding every item in COT-EFF-2 calibration/confirmation and the COT-EFF-1 screen prompts
sets.rc-confirmation: every remaining eval-heldout root_cause item (20), plus root_cause items of fresh secpatch sets built after this file, if any exist when confirmation runs
sets.rule: arms are compared on rc-calibration only; rc-confirmation runs once, for T and the chosen arm, after the choice is recorded here

grader: secpatch evaluate.grade with CWE identifier matching (commit 10243e3); a root_cause answer is correct if any CWE it names is a recorded CWE of the advisory
choice_rule: On rc-calibration: the fastest arm whose correct count >= T's. If none, the arm with the most correct among those >= 3.2x faster than T, reported as not meeting the bar.
adoption_rule: Adopted as Haven's root-cause path only if on rc-confirmation its correct count >= T's AND it is >= 3.2x faster than T. Then COT-EFF-2's task routing with this arm for root_cause is re-scored on COT-EFF-2 confirmation rows only if those rows exist for the arm; otherwise the end-to-end speedup is reported as an estimate, not a measurement.
power_note: 20 confirmation items cannot show a small difference: a 2-item loss is p >= 0.5. A pass means "no visible loss on 20 unseen items", and the weekly fresh sets extend it.

predictions.NC: 3-6x faster than T; accuracy near T if analogies carry the CWE

not_claimed: Nothing is trained. Load time and cold cache are out of scope.
runs_after: COT-EFF-2 confirmation (unit haven-coteff2-conf) has finished; the GPU must be free of everything except the allowed GLM teacher
